name: Do I need to winterize a frost-free hose bib?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to winterize a frost-free hose bib?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, you do not need to perform traditional winterization tasks like draining and shutting off the water supply for a properly installed frost-free hose bib. Its design automatically prevents freezing. However, it is crucial to disconnect any hoses or attachments from the spigot before freezing temperatures arrive. Leaving a hose connected can trap water in the faucet body, defeating the frost-free mechanism and potentially leading to damage. Regularly checking that nothing is attached to your frost-free hose bib during winter months is the main maintenance step needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, if properly installed, a frost-free hose bib doesn't require traditional winterization. Just ensure all hoses are disconnected before freezing temperatures.
